title: A Least-Privilege Permission Policy
description: The permission policy a deploy role grants, limited to only the actions the deploy performs.

steps.description: This is the permission policy the role grants. It should be least-privilege: only the actions the deploy performs.
`Action` lists exactly two actions, `s3:PutObject` and `cloudfront:CreateInvalidation`, never `"*"`.
`Resource` narrows each action to a specific bucket and distribution, so the role can touch nothing else.
